subject.title: feat(clickclack): session discussions — bound channels, side agent, lifecycle sync

question: Should the bundled ClickClack plugin ship this opt-in managed-discussion workflow, including a same-agent side session with narrowly scoped access to the attached main session?
rationale: The generic seam is already merged, but this PR adds a new configured bundled provider, an external managed-channel dependency, and a session-access model whose long-term product and operator contract needs explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded provider
options.body: Keep the ClickClack implementation in the bundled plugin after the unbound-tool repair and real lifecycle/routing proof are supplied.

options.title: Narrow to provider-only discussion links
options.body: Retain channel creation and embedding but defer side-agent routing and scoped main-session tool access to a separately reviewed design.

options.title: Move the integration outside the bundle
options.body: Treat ClickClack discussions as an external plugin implementation if maintainers do not want this product-specific workflow shipped in core distribution.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded provider
recommendation.body: Keep the ClickClack implementation in the bundled plugin after the unbound-tool repair and real lifecycle/routing proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged generic seam and the proposed provider implementation, making them the best available owner for the integration scope decision.
